name: esp2023_lock_gates
title: ESP 2023 lock gates (GA)
uses: ESP 2023 Task 2, Part B: the preferred design, a pair of mitre gates assembled from 41 separate parts. General arrangement, parts list, simulation of the gates opening.
description: Design A, the preferred design: a pair of steel mitre gates for a 4.2 m wide lock, 6 m high, holding up to 5.5 m of water. Each leaf is a welded steel frame of separate parts (heel post, mitre post, girders, stiffeners, skin plate) carrying oak fenders, seals, a walkway, lifting lugs and a gate paddle. It turns on a stainless pintle and an anchor collar with bronze bushes, has a position encoder on its pivot, and is driven by an electric actuator in an inspection chamber with a control panel, cover panels, a CCTV mast and an emergency call point.
